Type: Region (Mountain Range)
First Visited: Session 0

Description

The eastern mountain range forming part of the L-shaped border.
Dry and cold climate.
Barren, rocky, windswept, with sparse vegetation.
Feeds the @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.3Fsz5CXjF9SwnyKx]{Eastern Rivers} through deep springs and aquifers.
Less snow than the @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.Bao9p5LMs9wBf5j8]{Cinderwall} despite being cold.
Forms the eastern arm of the L-shaped mountain border, contrasting with the wet and volcanic Cinderwall to the south.

@UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.2oPdZNZmUGdavykO]{The Thirteen Spines}

Thirteen towers built along the Bonewall during the @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.yAiIJMlC7flCgMRm]{Imperium} era.
They rise from the mountain slopes like spines along a ridge — tall enough to peer over the crest of the Bonewall, but built on the slopes facing @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.bEFUlWN5ttWk0y59]{Beaconhold} rather than at the very summit.
The towers serve as both physical fortifications and magical wards, maintained by @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.Iz0ZE5ZJtcXABZl7]{The Light} to hold back forces of darkness on the far side of the mountains.

Each Spine has its own local nickname based on its appearance, history, or reputation — names given by the soldiers and scholars who have garrisoned them over the centuries.
The formal @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.yAiIJMlC7flCgMRm]{Imperium}-era designation for the tower network may exist in old records but has fallen out of common use; everyone simply calls them the Spines.
The towers are garrisoned by the @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.GVboNauNvVc8mHHi]{Spinewardens}, a military order of @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.bEFUlWN5ttWk0y59]{Beaconhold} sworn to maintain the wards.

One such Spine, a failing southern-ish tower, is known as Hallowreach, and a mausoleum for honored wardens lies beneath it.
When its wards began to fail and something from beyond the @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.2oPdZNZmUGdavykO]{Bonewall} pressed through, the garrison held until it became clear the Spine would fall.
A long-hidden ritual was offered to anchor the Light directly, but it required a sacrifice: the Spinewarden @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.yMtETX400iieRRXN]{Paxton Lumnus} volunteered, died, and closed the breach — only to wake afterward in the Spine's mausoleum, the Light burning in his heart and showing him that the wards themselves are flawed.

The northernmost Spine, Carnforth, marks the very edge of @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.bEFUlWN5ttWk0y59]{Beaconhold}'s territory and the king's reach.
Its light has now gone out — the first of the thirteen to go fully dark.

The ancient wards are now beginning to weaken as ruin's influence spreads, destabilized by the corrupted ritual at @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.v85bRcnzMrFiDdn6]{The Nodrum}.
Below the wall, between it and @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.5ieJV78RD0ZwDQRD]{Haven's Reach}, lies the marshy delta of @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.5ieJV78RD0ZwDQRD]{The Reaches}.

Connected Locations

  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.3Fsz5CXjF9SwnyKx]{Eastern Rivers} — Fed by springs and snowmelt from this range
  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.Bao9p5LMs9wBf5j8]{Cinderwall} — The other arm of the L-shaped border range
  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.nSK79xRnEUNF4khe]{Öuth Krelt} — The land beyond the Bonewall, held at bay by the Thirteen Spines
  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.5ieJV78RD0ZwDQRD]{The Reaches} — The marshy delta at the base of the wall in the far northeast
  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.Yaz5mCHyP6xdTwoc]{Witch Stones} — A ring of stones on the wall's dead shale, linked by portal to a matching ring in the @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.luKOvcjkjHGprDBX]{Ashen Vale}

Events Here

  • Session 0 — Established as the eastern mountain range
  • The wards at the Spine of Hallowreach failed and a breach opened from beyond the Bonewall; the Spinewarden @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.yMtETX400iieRRXN]{Paxton Lumnus} sacrificed himself in a hidden ritual to anchor the Light and seal the breach, then woke from death in the mausoleum
  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.SUWNsmWvbkJyVUMV]{Session 6} — Carnforth, the northernmost Spine, went dark; @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.2H09dC5u3Cx4I9uf]{Mira} opened a Witch Stone portal onto the wall's grey shale and stepped through, with @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.eNop3Y7Qd04NHq5f]{Garland} and @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.crg1JpVHgdUHPdOO]{Castor} following; in the @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.5ieJV78RD0ZwDQRD]{The Reaches} below the wall, @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.yMtETX400iieRRXN]{Paxton} burned @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.GVboNauNvVc8mHHi]{Senna}'s barge
